single-point:worker.title: Every request goes through one Checkout tasks
single-point:worker.message: It runs 1 replica, and every request from Ticket buyers goes through it: if it stops, Ticket buyers gets nothing.
single-point:worker.rationale: Redundancy is what turns one instance's availability into a service's: with two replicas, one can stop (a deploy, a crash, a node drained) while the other answers.
